raw_data_processing.note: NIST 'Data analysis flow', the official description of how the timetags become per-trial settings and outcomes.

repository.note: Landing page of the NIST Bell test repository, carrying the licence notice for the data and software. Not hashed: it is a mutable web page, last updated 2025-04-15.

provenance.derivation_from_raw_data: NIST 'Data analysis flow' (see pinned_sources.raw_data_processing): raw timetags are compressed, aligned on a common GPS pulse-per-second signal, screened for bad trials such as loss of pump mode-lock or a warming cryostat, merged with the settings and detector records, and reduced to per-trial settings and outcomes. Trials in which both setting lines fired are mapped to setting '0'.
provenance.outcome_table: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Supplemental Material Table S-II, 'Setting and measurement outcomes for the case of 5 aggregate pulses reported in the manuscript (Classical XOR3)'. Rows are the four settings pairs, columns the four joint outcomes, where '+' is any detection inside the coincidence window and '0' is no detection.
provenance.stopping_rule: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Supplemental Material Sec. I B: N was fixed before the analysis at 0.9 r f, with f the fraction of relevant trials estimated on a training set and r the trials remaining after it. Trials after the cut point were discarded. The p-value bound is only valid for such a predeclared N.
provenance.successes: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Table I, row '5' (N(++|ab)), listed independently as 'N_S' of the same Table S-I column.
provenance.sufficiency: The martingale binomial test of Supplemental Material Sec. I A uses only N, the number of trials whose settings and outcomes lie in T = {++ab, +0ab', 0+a'b, ++a'b'}, and N_S, how many of those are ++ab. Eq. (S2) bounds the p-value by a binomial tail in those two numbers alone, so the four table cells that make up T carry the whole test statistic. The remaining cells fix the settings frequencies, which bound the observed departure from equiprobable settings.
provenance.total_trials: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Table I, row '5' ('Total trials': every trial up to the stopping criterion, whether or not a photon was detected).
provenance.trials_in_T: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Table I, row '5' (N_stop), listed independently as the 'N Cut Point' of column 'pulses 4-8' in Supplemental Table S-I, run 'Classical XOR 3'.
